definitions.explanation: A flat shallow container for carrying or displaying things.
A Japanese Buddhist festival honoring the spirits of ancestors, typically in mid-August.

examples.japanese: お{茶|ちゃ}を{盆|ぼん}に{載|の}せて{運|はこ}ぶ。
{盆|ぼん}には{実家|じっか}に{帰|かえ}る。
examples.english: I go back to my parents' house during Obon.

examples.japanese: {盆|ぼん}と{正月|しょうがつ}が{一緒|いっしょ}に{来|き}たようだ。
examples.english: It's like Obon and New Year's came at the same time (extremely busy or happy).
examples.notes: [Note: This is an idiom meaning 'too much of a good thing' or 'extremely busy']

notes:
{盆|ぼん} has two main meanings: a serving tray and the Obon festival.

OBON FESTIVAL:
お{盆|ぼん} (Obon) is held in mid-August (or mid-July in some regions). It's one of Japan's most important holidays when people return to their hometowns to honor ancestors. Many companies close during this time.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{盆|ぼん} (Obon festival)
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り (Bon dance)
- {盆休|ぼんやす}み (Obon holidays)
- お{盆|ぼん}に{載|の}せる (to place on a tray)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- トレー (tray - loanword)
